Product arrived quickly and appears to be good quality. Nice packaging. The knobs are metal and have a nice heavy feel, similar to the original knobs that came with our stove.

However, as others have mentioned, the finish is definitely shiny and doesn't really match the brushed metal of the stove. You may not care if you're replacing all 5 knobs at once, but not a great option if you only need to replace one or two.
